description: This file contains implementation of the CordRepBtree class, which manages a B-tree based string representation in the Abseil library. It includes functions for tree validation, destruction, merging, copying, and manipulation of tree nodes and edges, as well as debugging utilities.

classes.name: CordRepBtree
classes.description: Represents a B-tree structure for string data in the Abseil library, providing methods for validation, manipulation, and debugging of tree nodes and edges.

classes.name: StackOperations
classes.description: A helper struct for building and unwinding stacks of tree nodes during modifications, ensuring proper ownership and sharing semantics.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Outputs a human-readable representation of the tree for debugging.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Recursively destroys a tree and its nodes, freeing resources.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks the structural integrity of the tree, optionally performing exhaustive validation.

methods.name: AssertValid
methods.description: Asserts the validity of the tree, aborting on failure.

methods.name: MergeTrees
methods.description: Merges two trees of the same or different heights into a single balanced tree.

methods.name: CopySuffix
methods.description: Creates a copy of the suffix of the tree starting at a given offset.

methods.name: CopyPrefix
methods.description: Creates a copy of the prefix of the tree up to a given length.

methods.name: SubTree
methods.description: Extracts a subtree from the current tree given an offset and length.

methods.name: RemoveSuffix
methods.description: Removes a suffix of specified length from the tree.

methods.name: ExtractFront
methods.description: Removes and returns the front element of the tree.

methods.name: ConsumeBeginTo
methods.description: Consumes nodes from the beginning up to a specified end index.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges two trees into one, balancing as needed.

methods.name: CreateSlow
methods.description: Creates a tree from a string representation, used for slow path construction.

methods.name: AppendSlow
methods.description: Appends a node or subtree to the current tree in a slow path.

methods.name: PrependSlow
methods.description: Prepends a node or subtree to the current tree in a slow path.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends string data to the tree.

methods.name: Prepend
methods.description: Prepends string data to the tree.

methods.name: Rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds the tree structure from a stack of nodes, optionally consuming the input.

methods.name: ExtractAppendBuffer
methods.description: Extracts a buffer from the tree for appending data efficiently.
